description: This file implements the SBC (Subband Codec) audio codec for Bluetooth A2DP in C++. It includes configuration, encoding, decoding, and quality management functionalities, as well as debug utilities.

classes.name: SBC
classes.description: A class implementing the SBC audio codec for Bluetooth A2DP, providing configuration, encoding, decoding, and quality adjustment functionalities.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the SBC codec based on stream format and settings string.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of the SBC codec into a stream format and settings string.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the supported or actual configuration into a byte stream.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes raw PCM frames into SBC frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes SBC frames into raw PCM frames.

methods.name: QOS
methods.description: Adjusts the quality of the SBC stream by modifying the bitpool.
